questions.stem: Which control best limits the blast radius of a compromised cloud credential?

answers.text: Scope the credential to a short-lived, least-privilege role
answers.explanation: Short-lived, least-privilege credentials limit what an attacker can do if the credential is stolen.

answers.text: Share one long-lived admin credential across all services
answers.explanation: Long-lived, shared admin credentials maximize the impact of a single compromise.
